messages:
morgan: Alert - multiple hosted API customers reporting 504s and 5xxs. p95 latency & tail timeouts. Dash shows request queue >95% on continuous batchers since 02:12 UTC.

devin: seeing the same. continuous-batcher backlog rising, dequeue throughput flat. p50 ~300ms, p95 jumped 12s. attaching quick metrics.

morgan: repro link: https://console.internal/repro/3855019876 (traces + flamegraphs).

devin: log excerpt: ```queue_depth=1240 depth_limit=1200 enqueue_rate=420/s dequeue_rate=280/s kvcache_miss_rate=0.87``` looks like enqueue > dequeue for ~10m.

tara: any single-tenant spike? customer side shows burst from tenant=clearslate at ~02:08 UTC. but other tenants affected too.

alex: noticed a config change rolled out 02:05 that increased depth_window from 400 -> 1200 to improve batching for embeddings. that aligns with timeline.

sre-luis: combining bigger depth_window + cold KV cache spinups -> long per-request prep times, so batcher holds onto requests waiting for larger batches, creating tail backlog.

morgan: support-bot created INC-3855, paging oncall.

support-bot: INCIDENT INC-3855 created and assigned to oncall. Incident runbook: hosted-request-queue-saturation.

oncall: ack, pulling traces and Batcher logs now. first step: enable early-reject policy for small requests and lower depth_window.

devin: can we run a hotfix: set depth_window=400 and enable early_reject=true on hosted-prod-batchers? Will that break throughput for steady-state? risk is minor, should reduce tail.

alex: preparing rollout. applying to one pool as canary. command: ```rdctl batcher update --pool hosted-prod-1 --depth_window=400 --early_reject=1```

morgan: noted. also add fallback routing to smaller model family for latency-sensitive routes while canary runs.

devin: canary applied to hosted-prod-1 at 02:28 UTC. metrics: queue_depth dropped from 1200 -> 480 within 30s, p95 down to 1.4s.

tara: customer-clear slate (tenant=clearslate) confirms errors stopped for them. other tenants improving.

alex: rolled to remaining pools by 02:36 UTC. monitor for regressions. KV cache warmups still causing some spread but early_reject prevents long holds.

sre-luis: root cause hypothesis: aggressive depth_window increase amplified KV cache miss stalls and allowed batchers to accumulate long-tail requests. The system lacked a guard to prevent single-tenant bursts from saturating global batcher queues.

morgan: mitigation summary: rolled back depth_window -> 400, enabled early_reject and tenant-aware admission limits, added temporary routing fallback and throttles for noisy tenants.

devin: open action items: 1) add pre-deploy safety check rejecting depth_window > 800 without feature flag; 2) add dashboard tile for tenant queue imbalances; 3) postmortem.

morgan: assigning items. creating postmortem draft. tagging product/infra for policy change.

oncall: incident resolved at 02:45 UTC. marking as mitigated. will follow up with detailed postmortem and customer communication. :white_check_mark:
